description: The zero, successor, and nonzero-limit supremum equations determine ordinal addition uniquely.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrdinalArithmetic.addition_recursion_unique.{u_1} (f : Ordinal.{u_1} → Ordinal.{u_1} → Ordinal.{u_1})
  (hz : ∀ (a : Ordinal.{u_1}), f a 0 = a) (hs : ∀ (a b : Ordinal.{u_1}), f a (b + 1) = f a b + 1)
  (hl : ∀ (a l : Ordinal.{u_1}), Order.IsSuccLimit l → f a l = ⨆ b, f a ↑b) : f = fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2
